summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with its July 2026 share buyback report. The board authorized on January 30, 2026 a repurchase of up to 100 million shares or JPY 60 billion, running from February 17 to September 30, 2026, excluding blackout periods. As of July 31, 2026, Nomura had repurchased 46,861,200 shares for JPY 59,999,879,300, reaching 46.9% of the share authorization but 100% of the yen cap. During the month, 2,300 treasury shares were disposed for RSUs. The buyback is nearly complete on a value basis, limited by the JPY ceiling.
